description: The image displays a donut chart illustrating the win rates (%) of three different models—LLaMA, GPT-4o, and a third model labeled "GPT-4o" in a distinct red segment—on a specific evaluation task. The chart is composed of three colored segments: a large light blue segment representing LLaMA with a win rate of 80.4%, a medium-sized dark blue segment for GPT-4o with a win rate of 19.6%, and a smaller red segment, also labeled GPT-4o, with a win rate of 12.0%. The labels for each segment are connected to the chart via lines and are positioned outside the donut, with the percentages clearly indicated. The central white space of the donut contains the text "Win rate (%)", indicating the metric being measured. The segments are arranged in a circular fashion, with the largest segment (LLaMA) occupying the majority of the chart, followed by the dark blue GPT-4o segment, and the smallest red segment. The chart uses distinct colors to differentiate between the models and clearly labels each segment with its corresponding win rate percentage.
